sources.title: LFM2.5-VL-DSpark: Accelerating vision-language models on edge and ...
sources.snippet: Today, we release an experimental DSpark draft model for our vision-language model (VLM) LFM2.5-VL-3B. As with our recently released LFM2.5-DSpark drafter models for our text-based Liquid Foundation Models (LFMs), it trades a minimal increase in memory footprint for substantially faster decoding without changing output quality.

sources.title: LFM2.5-VL-3B - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: ← Back to Vision Models LFM2.5-VL-3B is Liquid AI's most capable vision-language model, with strong grounding, screen and document understanding, and function calling. It builds on the LFM2.5-2.6B backbone with a SigLIP2 NaFlex image encoder, and answers directly for low-latency inference on-device and in the cloud.

sources.title: Liquid AI adds a 280M draft model to speed up its 3B vision model
sources.snippet: Liquid AI released a 280M-parameter draft model for LFM2.5-VL-3B, reporting faster decoding on Apple devices and Nvidia H100 GPUs, with smaller end-to-end gains.

sources.title: LFM2.5-DSpark: Up to 3.2x Faster Inference from H100 to MacBook
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-DSpark speculative decoding delivers up to 3.2x faster inference on GPU and 2.9x on-device. Day-one llama.cpp and SGLang support.

sources.title: LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-3B-MLX-4bit · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-VL-3B is a vision-language model built on the LFM2.5-2.6B backbone with a SigLIP2 NaFlex vision encoder (400M). It supports OCR, document comprehension, multilingual vision understanding, bounding box prediction, and function calling.
